observations.code_quote: **Custom property columns** surface the team's `CustomPropertyDefinition`s (loaded in `accountsColumnConfigLogic` via the generated `customPropertyDefinitionsList`) as a "Custom properties" picker group. Each is selected as ``accounts.custom_properties.values.`<definition-id>` AS cp_<id>`` — a JSON dot-access through the `custom_properties` lazy join on `system.accounts` (backed by the `customer_analytics_custompropertyvalue` EAV table; one JOIN regardless of column count). Because the alias is an opaque `cp_<id>`, every label-bearing surface must resolve it back via the `aliasToDefinition` selector: the table header (`useContextColumns` in `AccountsHogQLTable`) and the configurator's "Visible columns" list (`SelectedAccountColumn`). Cells render by display type (`CustomPropertyCell`: date→`TZLabel`, boolean→icon, select→`LemonColorGlyph` + label, numeric→`formatCustomPropertyValue`). Sorting a numeric custom property (display type `number`/`currency`/`percent`) casts the (string) JSON value with `toFloatOrNull(...)` in the `orderBy` — see `orderByExpression` in `accountsLogic`, driven by `aliasToDefinition` — so numbers sort by magnitude rather than lexically; non-numeric types sort by the alias directly. The stored sort state (URL hash, saved views) keeps the clean column name; the cast is applied only at query-build time. Numeric custom properties are also selectable in the **overview tiles** sum/avg/min/max/median/threshold pickers — `numericColumnOptions` recognizes the display type and wraps the value in `toFloatOrNull(...)` the same way so aggregation is numeric.

observations.code_quote: **Overview tile math** (`accountsOverviewTilesLogic` / `AccountsOverviewTilesEditor`). A tile's metric is a discriminated union: `count` (`count()`), the column aggregations `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max`/`median` (the metric-type name _is_ the HogQL aggregate fn, so `tileMetricExpression`'s one `default` branch emits `${type}(col)`), and `count_threshold` (`countIf(col op val)`, the only row-level-clickable tile). The column aggregations carry an optional `scale` multiplier (`applyScale`) rendered as `agg(col) * n`, e.g. `sum(mrr) * 12` to annualize; a `scale` of 1/undefined/non-finite is a no-op. `scaleSuffix` mirrors that guard for the `× n` label/caption suffix. Add a new aggregation by extending `COLUMN_AGGREGATE_TYPES` (must be a valid HogQL aggregate fn) plus the editor's `METRIC_TYPE_LABELS` / `COLUMN_AGGREGATE_LABEL_PREFIX`. No backend change: `accounts_query_runner` `parse_expr`s each metric string with no fn whitelist.
